highlights.title: Timesheet in Home
highlights.description: Open Timesheet in Quick Actions, choose a month and year, then export your Excel file.

highlights.title: Edit saved leave
highlights.description: Use Edit in History to change your leave. Dates, half days and Comp-Off credits are checked before saving.

highlights.title: Easier date selection
highlights.description: Choosing a Start Date also fills End Date. You can still change End Date separately.

releaseNotes: Timesheet export moved from Settings to Home Quick Actions with a month/year popup. Saved leave can be edited from History with validation. Choosing Start Date automatically fills End Date, which remains independently editable.
